name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Hangar cards and local-space hulls (all 20 player ships plus NPC/traffic/security) now paint as small grounded spacecraft: gray metal, 3/4 extrusion, panel seams, heat-tile sterns, ceramic engine bells, and framed dark glass.
Class hue is a material tint, not a glowing silhouette fill. Flight, docking, hitboxes, and menus are unchanged. Stars stay the 2.15.0 spectral pass.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.1 so Pages picks up the craft paint.
